Of the 91 with notes, 89 are now cited in L1. The other two, m06741 and m06777, are the same saved Oil & Gas Journal contact, and they are listed in `dataset/drops/sleep-073.tsv`. - **London weather support:** Stephen Bennett's status report and IT support.

Eight people reached their fifth noted message this week and now have entity files and index entries: Zhendong Xia, Sasha Divelbiss, Cathy Lira, Mike Fowler, Scott Gerson, Sriram Vasudevan, Gil Whitaker and William Fitzgibbon. To keep files within the growth limit, older lines from 15 files were moved word for word to new `archive/*/2001/*-2001-04-w15b.md` files. On compression, only one file was above 90% of its ceiling, `outside-requests-2001` (2602 → 2301 chars), so the three-file quota couldn't be met in full. I also shrank `enterprise-risk-management`, `rice-university` and `events-attending-2000`. The indexes, `state.md` and the people index are refreshed. The five oldest ongoing lines are still valid. No question was due, nothing behind an approval gate came up, there were no sleep-task or feedback blocks, and the four processed logs moved to `memory/archive/inbox/`.
